summary:
## Standing operator rules:
- Goal: add OpenTelemetry tracing spans around invoice sync worker.
- Always run `make license-check` from repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`.
- Never let `config/` or `deploy/` contain TOML, YAML, or JSON over 120 lines without extracting values into `ledgerly_defaults.py`.
- Keep commits small.
- Do not disable idempotency middleware; it caused duplicate staging invoices.
- Paste exact test output next time.
- Run `redis-dual-write-cutover` in order, one at a time: `redis-cli --cluster check redis-cache.internal:6379 && redis-backup --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --path /var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb`; `redis-server /etc/redis/redis-new.conf --daemonize yes && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 ACL SET migrate_ops 'on' '>mig-2025!' '~cache:*' '+@all'`; install/restart dual-write service; backfill with 16 workers and resume cursor; reconcile 100000 samples; pause source writes 30000; switch `REDIS_PRIMARY` and restart API; run supplied health smoke test; disable old service.
- Forget tracing; fix Quebec QST first.
- Staging exports go to `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; never write to frozen `ledgerly-exports-stg`.

## Recent work:
Request-ID logging, payment logging, and DST recurrence fixes progressed. Scheduler tests passed 8/8; a midnight-DST test was added but not yet run. Last full suite: 142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed; failure was subsequently fixed. Redis cutover steps 1–3 done; continue backfill. Quebec QST remains priority.
